name: San Domenico Palace, Taormina, A Four Seasons Hotel
positioning: Five-star hotel reimagined from a 14th-century convent, perched above the Ionian Sea in Taormina, Sicily
best_for: Travelers who want a Sicily base just off Taormina's main street
Guests drawn to historic architecture with sea views
Food lovers interested in Michelin-starred dining

facts.text: The hotel has 111 rooms in total.
The Ancient Convent Wing is built on the site of a 14th-century convent.
The Grand Hotel Wing is a Liberty-style structure added in 1896.
The hotel is just off the main street, an easy walk to shops and restaurants.
The hotel is 60 minutes from Catania-Fontanarossa Airport (CTA).
The clifftop infinity pool measures 21 metres (69 feet) in length.
Principe Cerami is a Michelin-starred restaurant.
Massimo Mantarro is the Executive Chef.
Botanica Spa has five treatment rooms.

highlights.text: Principe Cerami has sweeping vistas of Mount Etna and Taormina Bay.
Principe Cerami has a wine cellar of more than 1,000 labels.
Anciovi is a seafood restaurant with a poolside setting.
The Teatro Suite has a terrace overlooking both the sea and the Ancient Theatre.
The Sea-View Studio Suites each have a large terrace with a private plunge pool.
The hotel is recognized with Three Michelin Keys.

considerations.text: Catania-Fontanarossa Airport is 68.3 kilometers (42.4 miles) from the hotel.
Botanica Spa hours are 10:00 am to 8:00 pm every day.
WhataHotel notes the historic building layout may present accessibility considerations.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
